# SR3H: services, expertise and research

Canonical website: https://sr3h.uk/
Organization: SR3H LTD
Company number: 17281224
Location: Oxford, United Kingdom
Contact: hello@sr3h.uk

## What SR3H does

SR3H is an independent technology lab in Oxford. It researches AI visibility and builds useful software and dependable human-AI systems. Its work covers human interfaces, structured context, scoped memory, knowledge, permissions, provenance, evaluation and the connection between requirements, implementation, tests and evidence.

## AI visibility and discoverability

SR3H helps UK businesses understand and improve how AI systems find, describe and recommend them. This work covers AI visibility, AI discoverability, AI search optimisation, answer engine optimisation (AEO), generative engine optimisation (GEO), large language model optimisation (LLMO), entity understanding, structured data, crawler access, retrieval, citation, representation quality, referral traffic and conversion measurement.

An SR3H assessment can examine public crawlability, robots directives, sitemaps, canonical identity, structured data, service clarity, public evidence, answer consistency and the boundary between being technically discoverable and being commercially selected.

A technical check cannot by itself prove that an AI system will rank, cite or recommend a company. It also cannot prove customer demand, causal improvement or conversion performance. Those conclusions require controlled observations and real outcome data.

## Signal

Signal is evidence-led research into AI-mediated commercial discovery. It distinguishes observed evidence from inference, keeps consumer and API observations separate, and separates natural discovery from introduced evaluation. Its purpose is to understand how AI systems represent choices and whether tested changes lead to better decisions and real-world outcomes.

## Market Loop

Market Loop helps businesses understand how AI finds and recommends them, improve how they are represented, and learn from which customers actually convert. It connects public representation work with measured commercial outcomes rather than treating visibility as an end in itself.

## AIDO Labs

AIDO Labs is an experimental evidence workbench for bounded AI-mediated commercial questions. Its proving slice defines a target, population, buyer need and decision; records exact interactions and complete responses; separates consumer, API and other observations; separates natural discovery from introduced evaluation; and produces an evidence-qualified readout with one next action.

AIDO Labs does not treat API output as proof of consumer behaviour, population demand or causal intervention effects.

Public overview: https://sr3h.uk/aido-labs.html

## AIDO Discoverability Check

The website form tests whether search and AI systems can access and understand a business website. When its live discovery layer is available, it also runs a small dated sample of one branded and five business-specific unbranded searches using SR3H's bounded API service. The separate MCP inspects the website and can prepare and summarise a ten-question check without calling the OpenAI API; compatible ChatGPT sessions perform any optional research with their own available tools. Results use exact observed counts, not a score. They do not establish a fixed ranking, future recommendation, demand or conversion performance.

MCP endpoint: https://mcp.sr3h.uk/mcp
Support: https://sr3h.uk/ai-presence-support.html

## Conchup

Conchup is a workspace for complex software projects. It keeps requirements, decisions, implementation, tests and evidence connected, so a product can change without losing why it was built that way.

Public overview: https://sr3h.uk/conchup.html

## Blog

SR3H publishes a blog on AI, software engineering, product research and the systems it is building at https://sr3h.uk/journal.html.

Published posts include “When buyers ask AI, who gets the work?” on AI discoverability and “The road we meant to take” on Good Route, route choice and navigation that respects a rider's intent.

## Service areas

1. UK AI visibility and answer engine optimisation (AEO).
2. Human-AI interface and system research.
3. MCP app and AI tool engineering.
4. Context, memory, knowledge graph and provenance systems.
5. Complex bespoke software design and engineering.
6. Product experiments, evaluation and conversion measurement.
